name: Uisee Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Uisee Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd. provides AI-empowered autonomous driving solutions in China. The company designs and outsources the manufacturing of various vehicles, such as tractors, shuttle buses, trucks, and passenger cars/pickup trucks, as well as sample delivery vehicle, UiBox autonomous vehicle, the U-Drive system, and personal mobility solutions. It also provides autonomous driving kit solutions, autonomous driving software solutions, and autonomous driving vehicle leasing services.
